name: Listing Title Length
description: Verify that the listing title is between 10 and 100 characters.

name: Price Presence and Format
description: Ensure the price field is present, is a positive number, and is formatted with exactly two decimal places.

name: Image Count Minimum
description: Confirm that the listing contains at least 3 images.

name: Description Keyword Density
description: Check that the description contains at least 5 unique keywords from the provided category-specific keyword list.

name: Seller Rating Threshold
description: Verify that the seller's rating is 4.0 or higher on a 5.0 scale.
